test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 03 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Study the given pie chart and answer the question that follows.

The pie - chart is about Country-wise Global Exports Presentation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d001749f1966d1bd29608f54f92dcb8652b82d2e0b85d16b001ac631185d7ee.png] 

By how much does the value of the exports of UK exceed that of Australia (in billion)?
solution:
**Given:**

360° = 14400

**Calculation:**

360° = 14400

The value of the exports of UK exceeds that of Australia = 125° - 75° = 50°

⇒ (14400 × 50°)/360°

⇒ 2,000

**∴ Option 2 is the correct answer.**
